stock.description: YSB Inc. provides a comprehensive digital platform tailored for the Chinese pharmaceutical sector, supporting a wide array of stakeholders such as drug companies, distributors, vendors, pharmacies, and primary healthcare facilities. Its key offerings feature ClouDiagnos, a specialized diagnostic testing service; wePharmacy, an intelligent, unmanned pharmaceutical booth accessible 24/7 that facilitates connections between customers and professional pharmacist services; a suite of Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions; and YSB eLearn, which delivers online courses to prepare individuals for pharmacist qualification examinations. Beyond its digital offerings, the company engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of pharmaceutical and healthcare merchandise, and additionally provides medical testing services. The company was established in 2015 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
